title: gr silver reports significant drill results at san marcial 21 9 m at 168 g t ag including 6 15 m at 447 g t ag in the se area
body: GR Silver Reports Significant Drill Results at San Marcial: 21.9 m at 168 g/t Ag including 6.15 m at 447 g/t Ag in the SE Area News provided by GR Silver Mining Ltd. Jul 10, 2026, 07:30 ET Share this article Share to X Share this article Share to X VANCOUVER, BC , July 10, 2026 /CNW/ - GR Silver Mining Ltd. ( " GR Silver Mining" or the "Company" ) (TSXV: GRSL ) (OTCQX: GRSLF) (FRANKFURT: GPE) is pleased to announce positive drill results from the resource expansion drilling program at the San Marcial Area in the Plomosas Project, Mexico. Diamond drilling on the SE Extension target confirms the extension of high-grade silver mineralization for least an additional 150 metres to the southeast of the 2023 NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE") boundary.
